title: Birds and Ducks on a Snowy Islet（1961.260）
holder: 克利夫兰美术馆（藏品号 1961.260）
medium: Album leaf; ink and slight color on silk
one_line: 克利夫兰美术馆藏画作，馆方断代作「mid-1200s」。**本条为著录级**：照录馆方记录，未作阐释。

rows: Birds and Ducks on a Snowy Islet
Album leaf; ink and slight color on silk
Gift of the Womens Council of the Cleveland Museum of Art

basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录克利夫兰美术馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → southern-song；器类归入依据仅为：type=Painting。

items: Cahill, James. The Art of Southern Sung China. New York: Asia House, 1962.（cat. no. 9）
Lee, Sherman E. and Wai-Kam Ho. "Scattered Pearls beyond the Ocean." The Bulletin of the Cleveland Museum of Art, Vol. 51, No. 2 (Feb., 1964), pp. 23-39.（Reproduced: pp. 23-39, cat. no. 2）
Wang, Chi-chʻien. Album Leaves from the Sung and Yuan Dynasties: [Exhibition], March 26 Through May 30, 1970. New York: The [China House] Gallery, 1970.（cat. no. 6）

Ho, Wai-kam, Sherman E. Lee, Laurence Sickman, and Marc F. Wilson. Eight Dynasties of Chinese Painting: The Collections of the Nelson Gallery-Atkins Museum, Kansas City, and the Cleveland Museum of Art. Cleveland, OH: Cleveland Museum of Art, in cooperation with Indiana University Press, 1980.（Mentioned and Reproduced: cat. no. 26, pp. 47-48）
Tanenbaum, Mary. Fishing on the Terrace: A Collection of Writings, edited by Heather Parks. [Redwood City, CA]: Stanford University Press, 2018.（Reproduced: p. 120）

dating.text: 馆方给出了年代，**但未在公开记录中说明这个年代依据什么**——是铭文、器形序列、共出器物还是风格比对，无从得知。本库的断代十档因此无法填写：**填任何一档都是替馆方作了它没作的声明。**

colophons.text: 3 additional seals: 1 of Wu T'ing (c. 1600); 2 of Li Pao-hsun (1858-1915).
以上为克利夫兰美术馆藏品记录里的题跋与钤印著录，**本库未核对原件**；款印的真伪、题跋者身份与年代均未独立判定。

The Cleveland Museum of Art, Cleveland, OH
